title: Line Figures and Crowds
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 23 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Everything in this room is made of line. Figures are outlines, crowds are tangles, and where a body has color it is scribbled in, not painted. Twenty-three works, beginning with the first drawing in the whole collection on December 8, 2021, and ending with four from the start of June.

The lines change their job as the months go by. In the first week they pile up until a square is full: a crowd of toothy heads, a figure with wings, two black bodies edged in neon. In January they thin out, and a whole scene can be a few white strokes on purple. By June a figure is one black shape with a white edge, standing alone in a grey room.
Count the faces in each one. The room begins with more faces than you can count and ends with a single figure holding a bird.

chapters.title: The First Week
chapters.opening: Six works from December 8 to 12, 2021, including the very first New Nifty on the Block. The square is packed every time.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #1
works.text: The first work in the collection: a crowd of heads and raised limbs on cyan, drawn in red, blue, white and yellow scribble over black outline. Teeth are everywhere, in a skull at the top, a grinning head at the left, a jaw at the bottom edge. A hand with spread fingers reaches up at the upper left. Nothing is in front of anything else; the figures share one weave, and a face found in it is lost again as soon as the eye moves.
works.caption: A crowd of toothy heads and raised limbs in colored scribble over black outline, on cyan.
works.reading: The outlines are black and thick, and the colored scribble sits inside and across them without respecting the edges. The skull at the top has a square jaw of white teeth, and the head at the lower left has lashes drawn as a fan of black strokes. Yellow rays stand up from the shoulders like a collar. Recorded on December 8, 2021, at 07:26 UTC, two hours before #2.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #2
works.text: A green-faced figure with X eyes sits cross-legged in an orange body with two yellow wings spread behind it, on a ground of white, magenta and black strokes.
works.caption: A green-faced figure with X eyes sits cross-legged, yellow wings spread, on white with magenta strokes.
works.reading: The wings are drawn as two broad yellow shapes with blue and green scribble inside them, and the body is a knot of orange loops. The face is a green oval with two pink X eyes and a pink mouth. Magenta zigzags fill the corners. It has more recorded points than any other work in the room, 107,223.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #5
works.text: Two figures lean together on a pink and orange ground, one with yellow hair, both with round eyes and red mouths, and between them a large red heart. Two smaller hearts float at the sides. The bodies are drawn in green, yellow and white scribble with a thin white edge, and the big heart is outlined in white like a badge. It is the first drawing in the collection with a heart in it, and with 378 recorded strokes the most worked in this room.
works.caption: Two scribbled figures lean together over a large red heart, two smaller hearts at the sides, on pink.
works.reading: The yellow-haired figure on the left has a red mouth drawn as a filled oval with a grid of teeth, and the figure on the right grins. Their bodies merge below the big heart into one red mass. The pink at the bottom is soft and cloudy, drawn with wide pale strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #6
works.text: Two black figures edged in white and pink stand against a dark ground of colored scribble, one with an X in its eye and the other with a Y, a hand of three pink fingers between them.
works.caption: Two black figures edged in white and pink on dark scribble, one eye an X, the other a Y.
works.reading: The figures are solid black with a double outline, white inside pink, which makes them glow against the scribble. The left one has a yellow X in a blue ring and a small red mouth with white teeth. Grids of yellow and green lines sit at the bottom corners, and a blue zigzag runs down the right edge.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #7
works.text: One big face: two round red eyes with green X marks, a blue square eye between them, a mouth of white teeth, and thick swirls of red, blue and yellow line around the edge.
works.caption: A big face with green X marks in two round red eyes, white teeth, thick colored swirls around the edge.
works.reading: The lines are drawn in bands of four or five colors side by side, red, orange, blue and white, so every stroke is a ribbon. The two X eyes are lime green on red, the brightest marks in the picture. The teeth at the bottom are white blocks in a blue cage.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #8
works.caption: An olive maze of organic shapes outlined in white, small creatures hidden in the gaps.
works.reading: The shapes are outlined in white and orange, and the spaces between them are filled with grey scribble. A dog-like head sits at the top, a horned creature at the right, and a few small faces hide in the lower corners. There is no single figure, only the maze.

chapters.title: Rows and Crowds
chapters.opening: Mid December. The figures line up. Seven robed figures in a row, three lumpy ones side by side, a row of ghosts over black grass.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #10
works.text: A purple mass with four faces in it, each with a grin of white teeth and small yellow eyes, drawn in white line over an olive grid.
works.caption: A purple mass holding four grinning faces with small yellow eyes, drawn in white line over an olive grid.
works.reading: The faces are stacked: one large in the center, one at the left shoulder, one at the right, one below. All four grin with the same triangular teeth. The olive ground is ruled with a loose grid in green and orange, and the purple shape sits on it like a boulder.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #12
works.text: Seven tall figures stand in a row, their bodies long stripes of blue, green, pink and yellow, their round heads burning with orange and red scribble. Each face has two small eyes and a grin. The heads touch a band of fire along the top, so the row seems to stand under one burning roof. It is the first row of figures in the collection, and the tallest.
works.caption: Seven tall striped figures in a row, their round heads burning with orange and red scribble.
works.reading: The bodies are drawn in vertical strokes only, so the figures look like curtains. Their heads are circles filled with red and orange loops, and the loops run up into the band of fire at the top edge. The grins are drawn in a few white and red strokes. Recorded on December 16, 2021.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #13
works.text: Three lumpy figures in orange and blue scribble stand side by side on black, each with yellow eyes and a wide grin of white teeth.
works.caption: Three lumpy figures in orange and blue scribble stand side by side on black, each grinning.
works.reading: The three are drawn as one shape, edged in white, red and blue lines that run around all of them together. The scribble inside is orange with blue and white through it. The left figure is largest and its eyes are two yellow spirals.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #14
works.text: Six ghosts hang in a row under a pink sky, their long bodies drawn in thin blue, yellow and white lines that fall like rain, their faces screaming. Black grass stands up along the bottom in white outline. Three days after the row of seven burning heads, the row is back, but the fire has gone out: the heads are pale ovals with dark eyes and open mouths, and the bodies are see-through.
works.caption: Six ghosts in a row under a pink sky, their long bodies drawn in falling lines, mouths open.
works.reading: Each ghost has a different mouth: a round O, a grid of teeth, a jagged gap. The lines of the bodies run straight down and overlap, so the ghosts share edges. A yellow glow sits behind the middle of the row. The grass is drawn as a fringe of black blades with a white line around each.

chapters.title: Tangles
chapters.opening: January and February 2022. The lines loosen and multiply, and the figures are harder to find.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #19
works.text: A tangle of blue, orange and black line over olive and red, with two grinning heads at the top corners and a white line running around the edge like a frame.
works.caption: A tangle of blue, orange and black line over olive, two grinning heads at the top corners.
works.reading: The heads are small and drawn in red and blue, each with a row of white teeth. Between them the square is a web of long loose strokes with a seated figure buried in the middle. Sixty-one recorded strokes, but more than 56,000 points, which means long strokes drawn without lifting.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #22
works.text: A group of figures drawn in white, green and orange line on purple, their arms raised. One at the center has a dark face and both hands up. Twenty-nine recorded strokes make the whole drawing, and nothing is filled in; the purple shows through every body. It is the sparest crowd in the room, and the first where the line is nearly all that there is.
works.caption: A group of figures drawn in white, green and orange line on purple, arms raised, nothing filled in.
works.reading: The lines are drawn as long continuous loops that cross from one figure to the next, so the group is one piece of string. The central figure's face is filled with blue scribble, the only solid patch. Small boxes at the bottom corners are drawn in the same white loops.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #23
works.caption: A dark tangle of white, yellow and blue line over grey and olive, a horned shape at the center.
works.reading: The lines cross in every direction, and the shape in the middle, with two points at the top, could be a head or an animal. Patches of green and yellow scribble sit behind the line. The drawing is the least legible in the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #25
works.text: A figure hangs upside down behind five dark red bars on a red ground, its skull at the bottom with teeth showing, its legs crossed at the top.
works.caption: A figure hangs upside down behind five dark red bars on red, its skull at the bottom.
works.reading: The bars are drawn as thick horizontal strokes of dark red with a white line along each, and the figure is drawn in thin black and yellow line behind them. The skull below the lowest bar has two hollow eyes and a grid of teeth. Short spikes stand out from it like a crown.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #35
works.text: A figure in blue, orange and green scribble sits in a chair at a window, on pink, with a second small figure standing on the sill at the upper left.
works.caption: A scribbled figure sits in a chair at a window on pink, a smaller figure standing on the sill.
works.reading: The chair is drawn in dark purple with a white edge, and the figure in it has a pale face with red eyes and a few strokes of hair. The window is a frame of orange and purple bars. The small figure on the sill has a row of white teeth and a round eye, drawn in the same colors as the large one.

chapters.title: Spring Characters
chapters.opening: One week in March. Four drawings that are each a scene or a character, with the line now doing the describing.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #42
works.text: A cartoon scene on teal and pink: three smiling faces in a box of yellow dots, a round green tree with a face, a yellow snail with antennae, and pink clouds along the top.
works.caption: A cartoon scene: three smiling faces in a box, a green tree with a face, a yellow snail, pink clouds.
works.reading: The tree is a circle of green loops ringed with lime dots, with a small face in the center and a red trunk below. The snail at the lower left is drawn in yellow line with a spiral shell. The clouds are pale strokes with a zigzag under them. It is the one drawing in the room that looks like a picture book.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #43
works.text: A group of figures in white and yellow line on orange, a grinning monkey at the left and four others with round heads, over a ground of colored bars.
works.caption: Figures outlined in white and yellow on orange bars, a grinning monkey among them.
works.reading: Each figure is drawn in a double line, yellow inside white, and the monkey's grin is a row of small teeth in a wide mouth. The bars behind them run horizontally in red, green, blue and purple. A blue oval at the center sits between the figures like a table.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #45
works.text: A figure with square glasses and a wide grin crosses its arms, drawn in black, white and green hatching over an orange ground, spikes of hair standing up.
works.caption: A figure with square glasses and a wide grin crosses its arms, hatched in black and green on orange.
works.reading: The hatching is dense and runs in different directions on the face, the arms and the chest, so the figure has weight. The glasses are two white frames with small eyes inside. The grin is a bar of white blocks. Spikes of line stand out from the head and shoulders.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #46
works.text: A figure with a huge round head dances with one arm up and one out, drawn in red, white and blue line on dark teal, its face a swirl with a small grin.
works.caption: A big-headed figure dances with one arm up, drawn in red, white and blue line on dark teal.
works.reading: The head is a wide oval filled with loose red and white loops, with two spiral eyes and a mouth of small white teeth. The body is a thin knot of line, and the legs end in two black strokes that make a tripod. Twenty-five recorded strokes, the fewest in the room.

chapters.title: Four from Early Summer
chapters.opening: After nine weeks, four works from May 30 to June 3. A crowd of yellow characters, then two figures alone in grey rooms, then a pair with red heads.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #117
works.text: A crowd of yellow characters with spiky hair on pale blue, the one in front wearing sunglasses and a white tee that says NIFTY INK, pale faces floating behind them.
works.caption: A crowd of yellow spiky-haired characters on pale blue, the front one in sunglasses and a NIFTY INK tee.
works.reading: The characters are drawn in yellow line with black for the sunglasses, the hair and the trousers, and the ones behind are only outlines in pale green. The lettering on the tee is black on white. The one at the left has fangs and X eyes; the one at the lower left has a white vest and a row of teeth.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #121
works.text: A black figure in a suit stands in a grey room, drawn with a thin white edge, its head stretched sideways like a balloon with two X eyes on it. A single yellow flower grows at the lower right. Thirty recorded strokes. In December the black figures were edged in neon and surrounded by scribble; here the same black body stands in nothing at all, and the room is empty except for the flower.
works.caption: A black suited figure with a sideways balloon head and X eyes stands in a grey room by a flower.
works.reading: The suit is drawn with a few white lines for the lapels, the cuffs and the creases, and the figure leans slightly to the left, its head pulled out to the right. The flower at the corner is the only color: yellow petals, a red center, a green stem. The room is a grey square inside a lighter grey border.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #129
works.text: A tall black figure with a white edge stands at the right of a grey room and holds out its arm, and on its hand sits a small purple bird with a yellow beak. The figure's face has two spiral eyes and a row of teeth. A darker square is drawn on the wall behind it. The bird is the one colored thing in the picture, and the whole arm is drawn to carry it.
works.caption: A tall black figure in a grey room holds out its arm, a small purple bird perched on its hand.
works.reading: The figure's body bends at the hip and knee, and the legs are drawn as long black strokes with white lines for the trousers. The spiral eyes are drawn in white on black. The darker square behind the figure is a frame within the frame, and the bird sits just outside it.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #136
works.text: Two figures with red heads and black hair stand on a yellow ground ruled with white lines, a red heart between them and X marks on their faces, six months after the hearts of December.
works.caption: Two figures with red heads and black hair stand on ruled yellow, a red heart between them.
works.reading: The red heads are circles with white X marks and zigzags for mouths, and the left one has long black hair drawn in straight strokes. The heart is outlined in pink and dark red. Purple capsules run up the middle like buttons, and red and black boots stand at the bottom edge. The white ruling is drawn over everything.

closing: Go back to the first work and then to the figure with the bird. Both are made of line. One has more faces than you can count and fills the square to the corners; the other has one face, one arm and one small bird, and most of the square is empty wall. The room is the distance between them.
